protocol.normal: unit world-space Blender EXR vs normalized rasterized world normals; signed angular MAE in degrees
protocol.normal_component: mean absolute XYZ component error on unit normals
protocol.depth: positive camera Z in original world units; no scale, shift, ICP or per-frame alignment
protocol.foreground: GT alpha >= 0.5 and GT ray hit when available
protocol.visibility: predicted alpha >= 0.5; invalid predictions excluded from conditional MAE and counted in coverage
protocol.depth_derived_normal: centered finite differences of expected Z depth with pixel center +0.5

normal_metrics.gs_render: GS Render Normal MAE: normalized alpha/transmittance blended surfel normals vs GT Normal EXR
normal_metrics.depth_normal: Depth Normal MAE: expected Z -> world points -> finite-difference normals vs the same GT Normal EXR
normal_metrics.mesh: Mesh Normal MAE: predicted triangle mesh -> first ray hit -> interpolated geometry-derived vertex normal; camera-facing; vs the same GT Normal EXR
normal_metrics.missing_mesh: not_available/null when no predicted mesh; never substitute GT mesh/EXR consistency error
normal_metrics.common_pixels: common_normal_metrics scores available normal methods on the identical valid-pixel intersection
normal_metrics.legacy: normal.angular_deg and normal_coverage are aliases of GS Render Normal; depth_derived_angular_deg is Depth Normal

protocol.aggregation: frame_mean: equal frame weights; pixel_mean: valid pixel weights; never average frame medians as a global median
protocol.primary: foreground; interior is a supplementary boundary diagnostic; no object or material subsets
